fib: ______ is one of the major roles of healthcare managers.
Measurement of needs
Measurement of Needs Measurement of needs is one of the major roles of healthcare managers.
______ is a western type of scientific medicine which is made up of hospitals, clinics and primary health centres and it is provided by private and public sectors.
Orthodox health care
Orthodox health care is a western type of scientific medicine which is made up of hospitals, clinics and primary health centres and it is provided by private and public sectors.
______ refers to legal practice, scholarship and advocacy on issues involving the government's legal authorities and duties to prevent the spread of diseases and promote the citizen's health.
Public health law

Public health law refers to legal practice, scholarship and advocacy on issues involving the government's legal authorities and duties to prevent the spread of diseases and promote the citizen's health.
